messages.subject: Product Flaw
messages.text:
Hello, 

 I just received the items from my order, number L-46015. Nearly everything is perfect, but the Milkweed Neck Warmer in Charcoal Grey has an issue with the stitching on one side. I'm attaching a photo. Is there a possibility of a refund or exchange?
 

 Thank you,
 Brendan

messages.text:
Hi Brendan,

 Warmly,
